settings.heading: How long does a piece take?
settings.text: Twenty-one days from order to shipping. Resizing adds three. Engraving adds two, and engraved pieces cannot be rushed.

settings.heading: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.text: Within three days, yes, in full. After that the piece is on the bench and the gold has been cut.

settings.heading: What happens when a chapter closes?
settings.text: It is not made again. Archive pieces occasionally return, and those are final sale.

settings.heading: Do you make anything to commission?
settings.text: A few times a year. Write to us with what you have in mind and we will say plainly whether it is something we should make.

settings.heading: Ordering
settings.intro: Everything here is answered by a person if you would rather ask.

settings.heading: Where does the gold come from?
settings.text: Recycled and refined in São Paulo. We can show the refiner's certificate for any piece.

settings.heading: What is the difference between 18k, vermeil and silver?
settings.text: 18k is solid gold throughout. Vermeil is a heavy gold layer over silver 950 and will wear through eventually. Silver 950 is silver, and it darkens.

settings.heading: Will it irritate my skin?
settings.text: 18k and silver 950 are nickel-free. Vermeil is nickel-free at the surface, and the silver beneath it once the layer wears.

settings.heading: Are the stones natural?
settings.text: Every stone is natural and bought from one of two cutters we have used for eleven years. Nothing is treated beyond cutting and polishing.

settings.heading: Can a piece be resized later?
settings.text: Free for life, up to three sizes either way. Post it back and we return it insured.

settings.heading: My silver has gone dark. Is that a fault?
settings.text: No, it is what silver does. A soft cloth handles it, and we re-polish free whenever you send a piece in.

settings.heading: Do you repair pieces you did not make?
settings.text: We do, quoted before any work starts. We will also tell you when it is not worth the money.

settings.heading: How is a piece sent?
settings.text: Insured and signed for, everywhere. Tracking arrives the morning it leaves the bench.

settings.heading: Do you ship outside Brazil?
settings.text: Yes. Duties and import taxes are the customer's, and we declare the full value — we will not under-declare a parcel.

settings.heading: What is the returns window?
settings.text: Thirty days, unworn, in the original wrapping. Engraved and archive pieces are final sale, and we say so before you order.

settings.heading: Still unanswered?
settings.intro: A person reads every message. We reply within two working days.
